CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFTREEITEM

CFTREEITEM, nested in CFTREE, adds one item to the tree, placed under the item named by PARENT. With QUERY it adds an item for every row instead, and a comma-separated list of columns in VALUE builds several levels at once (for example departments, then the employees in each).

Category

Forms

Syntax

<CFTREEITEM VALUE="text"
    DISPLAY="text"
    PARENT="parent_value"
    IMG="image"
    IMGOPEN="image"
    HREF="URL"
    TARGET="window_name"
    EXPAND="Yes/No"
    QUERY="query_name"
    QUERYASROOT="Yes/No">

Attributes

VALUE
Required. The item's value, which is what gets submitted when it is selected. With QUERY, a column name or a comma-separated list of column names, one per tree level.
DISPLAY
Optional. Text shown for the item. Defaults to VALUE. With QUERY, a matching list of columns.
PARENT
Optional. VALUE of the parent item. Leave it out for a top-level item.
IMG
Optional. Icon: folder, document, cd, computer, fixed, floppy or remote, or the URL of a 16x16 image. The default is a folder for items with children and a document for the others.
IMGOPEN
Optional. Icon for an expanded folder. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
HREF
Optional. Makes the item a link. CFTREEITEMKEY=value is appended to the URL.
TARGET
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
EXPAND
Optional, default "Yes". No shows the item's children collapsed at first.
QUERY
Optional. Query whose rows become tree items.
QUERYASROOT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

Parents must be defined before their children. Items built from a query get a path as their value: with VALUE="Department,Emp_ID" an employee item's value looks like "/Engineering/12", so use ListLast(value, "/") to get the key. Query-built branches start collapsed unless EXPAND="Yes"; IMG may be a comma list with one icon per level (otherwise folders and documents are chosen automatically).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFIF IsDefined("URL.CFTREEITEMKEY")>
  <CFOUTPUT><P>You clicked the item <B>#HTMLEditFormat(URL.CFTREEITEMKEY)#</B>.</CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>

<CFFORM NAME="Map" ACTION="cftreeitem.cfm">
<CFTREE NAME="SiteMap" WIDTH="320">
  <CFTREEITEM VALUE="server" DISPLAY="KoldFusion Server 4.5" IMG="computer">
  <CFTREEITEM VALUE="docs" DISPLAY="Documentation" PARENT="server">
  <CFTREEITEM VALUE="langref" DISPLAY="CFML Language Reference"
      PARENT="docs" HREF="cftreeitem.cfm">
  <CFTREEITEM VALUE="snippets" DISPLAY="Examples" PARENT="docs"
      HREF="cftreeitem.cfm">
  <CFTREEITEM VALUE="admin" DISPLAY="Administrator" PARENT="server" EXPAND="No">
  <CFTREEITEM VALUE="datasources" DISPLAY="Data Sources" PARENT="admin"
      IMG="fixed" HREF="cftreeitem.cfm">
  <CFTREEITEM VALUE="verity" DISPLAY="Verity Collections" PARENT="admin"
      IMG="cd" HREF="cftreeitem.cfm">
</CFTREE>
</CFFORM>
